join.title: Apply to join XKnot
join.lede: There are only two ways in. Either the site already has its own domain, or the hub issues it a subdomain. The mode decides the address.
join.step3desc: Connect the chosen mode; the site is listed after its public /api/health passes.
join.terms: By submitting, the site agrees to the federation terms: it hosts no other instance's content, and accounts and data stay on its own machine.
join.contactHint: Write here for review, changes, or reinstatement.

form.name: Site name
form.modeOwnDomainHint: The site already runs on your domain. That address is the identity; the hub issues nothing and redirects nothing.
form.modeSubdomainHint: The hub issues <label>.xknot.si, serves the static site from the entry, and tunnels dynamic requests back to you.
form.domainHint: A full https domain. /api/health must answer at its root.
form.subdomainHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 2–32 characters. Issued by the hub.
form.introPlaceholder: What the site collects, and for whom.
form.timezoneHint: Taken from your browser. Edit it if the site runs elsewhere.
form.agree: This site follows the federation terms. Content, accounts and data stay on its own machine.

formError.summary: A few fields still need attention.
formError.name: Use 2–40 characters.
formError.domain: Enter a full https domain; xknot.si subdomains are not allowed here.

subdomain.invalid: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 2–32 characters.
subdomain.reserved: That name is kept for the hub itself.
subdomain.taken: That subdomain already has an open application.

formError.duplicate: This address is already in the review queue.
formError.rate: Too many submissions. Try again later.
formError.generic: The application did not go through. Please retry.
formError.offline: Cannot reach the API. Is it running?

done.title: Application received
done.body: It is in the manual review queue, and the reviewer has been notified. We will write to the contact email once a decision is made.
